title: Operator shielding: RBAC graph enforcement and KMS origin proofing
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Adds operator-scoped RBAC graph enforcement, a KMS origin attestor for incoming envelopes, and a sealed-audit gateway that tags and signs region-bound audit entries. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via config flags for Private/Dedicated installs.
description:
Summary: Implements an operator shielding layer that enforces RBAC v2 constraints at the operator graph level and validates KMS-origin proofs for service-submitted encryption envelopes. Also introduces a sealed-audit gateway which normalizes, tags, and signs audit records with region and origin metadata before they are emitted to downstream sinks. This is an opt-in safety control intended for Dedicated and Private deployments that require strong operator isolation and cryptographic provenance of KMS usage.

Motivation & context: Several customers and internal audits identified two related risks: (1) operator principals with broad operator-like permissions being able to escalate across tenant boundaries via ephemeral admin flows, and (2) ambiguous KMS-origin metadata making it hard to prove that a given ciphertext was produced by an allowed provider/region. This PR addresses both by adding a graph-based RBAC enforcement layer that evaluates operator reachability and by validating KMS-origin assertions embedded in envelopes at ingress. Paired with the sealed-audit gateway, we get a tamper-evident, region-aware audit trail that improves compliance posture.

What I changed (high level):
- rbac/graph: new enforcement engine that computes operator reachability, supports time-bound grants, and denies paths that cross tenant isolation boundaries unless explicitly permitted.
- kms/attestor: component that verifies envelope provenance claims (KMS provider ID, region tag, attestation signature) and rejects envelopes with missing or invalid proofs.
- audit/sealed_gateway: HTTP service that accepts internal audit events, enriches with region/operator provenance, signs the payload with a host-managed audit key, and forwards to configured sinks (S3, BigQuery, Kafka).
- config: new feature flags (operator_shielding.enabled, kms_origin_proof.required, audit.sealed_gateway.enabled) with default off for existing hosted tenants.
- tests: unit and integration tests for graph evaluation, a KMS attestation fixture, and end-to-end flow tests for audit signing and sink delivery.
- docs: design doc and runbook additions under docs/security/operator-shielding.md and deploy notes in private-installer/README.md.

  if evaluator.PathCrossesIsolation(subject, target) && !policy.AllowCrossTenant(subject, target) {

CI history: initial CI run (2024-11-19) failed on a flaky integration test (operator_shield_flow_test.go), reran after adding a small wait fix in the test harness; subsequent runs passed (all checks green: unit, linters, integration-on-docker, e2e-smoke). Final CI status: pass.

Backward compatibility & migration notes:
- This change is opt-in via feature flags; default is off for hosted tenants to avoid unexpected rejects.
- For Dedicated/Private customers who enable kms_origin_proof.required, they must ensure their envelope-producing KMS (CMKs) attach the new provenance headers (provider-id, region, attestor-signature). We added a small helper library (kms/attestor/client.go) to help partners emit compliant envelopes.
- Audit gateway can be deployed sidecar or as a central service; deploy notes included. The gateway signs with a local key and publishes key metadata for offline verification; operators should rotate signing keys via documented procedure.

Security review & compliance impact:
- SEC performed a security review on 2024-11-26 and signed off on the design provided the HSM-backed signing requirement is followed for regulated customers.
- The feature enables stronger evidence collection for KMS usage and reduces operator blast radius by preventing implicit operator escalation paths.

Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2024-12-03 after all approvals and green CI. Changelog entry created under CHANGELOG.md and release notes prepared for the next patch release.

Follow-ups / future work:
- Replace expression evaluator with sandboxed WASM policy expressions (ENG-9002).
- Add telemetry-driven policy simulation mode to measure the impact before turning on enforcement.
- Implement tokenized audit export format for long-term archival to meet retention and zero-knowledge audit scenarios.

If you want to try it locally: see docs/security/operator-shielding.md and run tests with TEST_KMS_ATTEST_FIXTURE=1 make test-integration."
